mapping_policy: CPA_PRIOR_ART shall be implemented generously toward the cited reference but shall not be credited with GBI-specific dependency states unless expressly or necessarily supported. Ambiguity is logged, not silently resolved.
prospective_participant: VM/virtualized compute-service structural participant represented by a compute event/request

mappings.source_behavior: VM instantiation request or detected compute event
mappings.implemented_behavior: Create an informational candidate record carrying tenant/service/resource parameters before policy evaluation.
mappings.gbi_feature_intentionally_excluded: No automatic conclusion that this informational record is a GBI Candidate Representation for legal purposes.

mappings.source_behavior: Policy information such as SLA information is retrieved for the detected compute event.
mappings.implemented_behavior: Deterministic policy function evaluates event attributes against a frozen eligibility predicate.
mappings.gbi_feature_intentionally_excluded: No automatic attribution of the full GBI GRI ontology.

mappings.source_behavior: Policy-based determination whether the VM/compute event is authorized.
mappings.gbi_feature_intentionally_excluded: Authorization does not by itself create the GBI Instantiation Boundary/ISP/MRC chain.

mappings.source_behavior: Appropriate/relevant data-center resources/services are provisioned/configured if authorized.
mappings.implemented_behavior: Authorized events receive associated service/provisioning operations.
mappings.gbi_feature_intentionally_excluded: Associated service provisioning is not silently equated with acquisition of GBI ISP.

mappings.source_behavior: The reference contains request-triggered language and also language permitting compute-event detection in response to hypervisor instantiating a VM.
mappings.implemented_behavior: CPA_PRIOR_ART uses a conservative dual-state model: the VM structural unit is counted as instantiated when the source-supported compute-event pathway has crossed into VM structural existence; associated policy-controlled services remain separately modeled. A run is invalid if implementation logic retroactively prevents that already-instantiated unit merely to mimic GBI.
mappings.gbi_feature_intentionally_excluded: No imported rule that policy denial necessarily prevents acquisition of VM ISP.

fail_closed_checks: CPA_PRIOR_ART may not call the GBI pre-instantiation gate function.
CPA_PRIOR_ART may not erase or un-count a structural unit after it has been marked instantiated.
CPA_PLUS_GBI must differ from CPA_PRIOR_ART only by the GBI dependency intervention plus trace labels needed to observe it.
GBI-designated arms require authorization before instantiation-boundary crossing and MRC after ISP.
Any source-to-implementation assumption must be logged in IMPLEMENTATION_ASSUMPTIONS.json in the evidence directory.
